name: Ca ro Tong Truong
summary: Cá rô Tổng Trường is the perch named at midday in Tam Coc with mountain goat and crisp rice. In Hoa Lư, where Tổng Trường is the old name of xã Trường Yên, it is cooked rang, rán, kho, or as canh chua, and it is also placed in the city or the old capital.
origin: Tổng Trường, the old name of xã Trường Yên in Hoa Lư, and a midday plate in Tam Coc.
howToEat: At midday in Tam Coc it is named with mountain goat and crisp rice.
In Hoa Lư it is cooked rang, rán, kho, or as canh chua, with fried perch, pickled mustard greens, diluted nước dưa, tomato, and fried tofu.
On a Ninh Bình Tet table it is kho tộ or rán giòn, with hot rice.
where: Thành phố Ninh Bình or the old capital, and Cố đô Hoa Lư.
seoTitle: Ca ro Tong Truong — Tam Coc midday perch
seoDescription: Perch named at midday in Tam Coc with mountain goat and crisp rice, and cooked rang, rán, kho, or canh chua in Hoa Lư.
